description: Whether a claimed edge survives replication on your own returns. use it rather than `verify_edge_replication` for edge replication specifically; an object with 7 fields including accepted_fields, detail. $3 USDC.

claimed.description: Optional: {sharpe, cagr, max_dd} — your stated figures. When supplied they are compared against the computed ones and a mismatch is a named finding.
claimed.title: Claimed

frequency.description: 'daily' or 'per_trade'. REQUIRED. A daily series is annualised with sqrt(252); a per_trade series is reported PER TRADE and is never annualised, because a per-trade series has no knowable trades-per-year.
frequency.title: Frequency

returns.description: The return series, as a JSON list of numbers. EITHER this or 'returns_csv_b64' is required, never both. At most 200000 observations; a longer series is a 400 naming the limit. NaN and infinity are rejected — they are not a return series.
returns.title: Returns

returns_csv_b64.description: The return series as a base64-encoded CSV, one number per row. The alternative to 'returns'. Decoded size is capped at 1 MB.
returns_csv_b64.title: Returns Csv B64

strategy_shape.description: Optional: {type, instrument, timeframe}. 'type' is one of trend | mean_reversion | breakout | other and selects the calibration bucket; 'instrument' selects the instrument-class bucket. Instruments are NORMALISED (EUR/USD == EUR_USD == eurusd).
strategy_shape.title: Strategy Shape

trials_attempted.description: How many configurations you tried before keeping this one. REQUIRED, and must be >= 2. This is the number that makes the Deflated Sharpe meaningful: a Sharpe of 2.0 found after 500 tries is priced for what it is. We never assume trials = 1.
trials_attempted.title: Trials Attempted

name: evaluate_edge_replication

error.description: The machine-readable error code, when the operation failed.

note.description: A note on how the answer was produced.

title: Evaluate Edge Replication
